harness.antimatter: AntimatterReplica: replica of antimatter/src/src/Antimatter.sol mint gate (owner-or-EnumerableSet approved minter, NotApprovedMinter revert, OZ ERC20 _mint). Real Antimatter not importable without @phUSD/@phUSDMinter remappings + solc 0.8.27; mint() is the only surface NFTBonfire uses. Gate is live: bonfire explicitly setApprovedMinter'd.
harness.seed: bonfire setAuthorizedBurner on NFTMinterV2; setApprovedMinter on Antimatter; pauser=0x9A05E; 4 actors x 3 ids x 3 NFTs; 30 idle days at rate 0, then ratePerDay=2.5e18
actions: burn(actor, id, minPayout mode: 0 | ==pending | pending+1 | random<=1e24)

invariants.name: invariant_1_emissionTimeBounded
invariants.description: (AM totalSupply + pendingPayout) * 1 day <= ghost Σ ratePerDay_i * dt_i (integral synced from block.timestamp deltas, so Medusa's auto time-advance is included); and AM totalSupply == Σ observed payouts

invariants.name: invariant_2_burnOnlyFromCaller
invariants.description: After every successful burn, only msg.sender's balance of the burned id drops, by exactly 1; every other (actor,id) ERC1155 balance is unchanged (4 actors x 3 ids snapshotted pre/post)

invariants.name: invariant_4_noPreRateAccrual
invariants.description: Before ratePerDay is ever non-zero, pendingPayout()==0 and accruedStored==0 (deterministic 30-day idle leg in constructor), and the pot is 0 at the instant the first non-zero rate is set

invariants.name: invariant_5_pausedBurnReverts
invariants.description: paused => burn reverts; any reverted burn leaves all NFT balances, all AM balances and AM totalSupply unchanged (atomicity)

invariants.name: invariant_6_setterCheckpoint
invariants.description: After setRatePerDay/setMaxPayout, accruedStored == min(oldCap, stored + (now-last)*oldRate/1d) computed by an independent shadow model, and lastUpdate == now

invariants.name: invariant_7_payoutMatchesModel
invariants.description: pendingPayout() == shadow model at all times; each burn pays exactly pre-call pendingPayout, >= minPayout, never at rate 0; payee AM delta == payout

invariants.name: invariant_8_eligibleBurnLiveness
invariants.description: Not paused, rate != 0, caller holds the id, minPayout <= pending => burn succeeds

invariants.name: invariant_9_supplyConservation
invariants.description: Σ actor balances == NFTMinterV2.totalSupply(id) for every id
